messages:
ian: Heads-up — onboarding sample app is failing during route creation. REST POST returns 201 but SDK client returns 422 (validation: missing model_variant). Anyone seen this parity/serialization gap?

tori: Can you paste both payloads? my guess is serializer differences (seconds vs ms) or DTOs missing fields.

ian: Repro below. REST (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -d '{"name":"onboard-lite","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v2","timeout":25}'
```
SDK (fails):
```js
// using @redwood/sdk-js v2.1.0 in sample-app
client.routes.create({ name: 'onboard-lite', model: 'gpt-open-3', timeout_ms: 25000 })
// autocomplete doesn't show model_variant; sending extra keys gets dropped silently
```

tori: Yep — two problems here: 1) SDK exposes timeout_ms and converts to ms on wire; server expects numeric seconds under "timeout" for this endpoint, 2) SDK's serializer strips unknown top-level keys (so model_variant never reaches API). Both lead to 422.

chao: Also noticed the onboard wrapper enables global autoRetry. For non-idempotent POST this caused a duplicate route after an infra 502. Customer reported two routes.

ian: Logs show duplicate POSTs a second apart and no Idempotency-Key header.
```
[2027-05-08T16:02:01Z] POST /v1/routes req_id=r_1 - upstream=502
[2027-05-08T16:02:02Z] POST /v1/routes req_id=r_2 - created
```
No idempotency header present because SDK didn't expose helper.

tori: Short-term mitigation: callers can add Idempotency-Key in headers and turn off autoRetry for create calls. Example: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ autoRetry: false, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': uuid() } })
client.routes.create({ name, model, model_variant: 'v2', timeout: 25 })
```
That prevents duplicates until we ship a permanent fix.

chao: I'll open a ticket with repro and exact sdk version. Proposed fixes for the SDK: 1) expose model_variant on route create shapes, 2) accept timeout or timeout_ms and normalize to seconds for the API, 3) stop dropping unknown top-level keys for create payloads (or at least surface a warning), 4) change retry middleware to only autoRetry idempotent methods; require Idempotency-Key opt-in for POST.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-6122: "js-sdk: route create parity — expose model_variant, normalize timeout parameter, and restrict POST retries; add idempotency helper" — https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-6122 :robot_face:

ian: I'll attach the failing sample-app, a minimal repro, and a quick integration test that compares SDK-serialized json to canonical REST json. Could we also add a lint in SDK release pipeline that verifies shape parity for critical endpoints?

tori: Good idea — a CI check that serializes example payloads and diffs to a golden REST schema would catch this earlier. I'll jot that down in the ticket.

chao: Ops follow-up: suggest adding a temporary alert that detects multiple route creations from the same account with identical payload within 3s. That should catch duplicates while SDKs get patched.

ian: Thanks — adding the alert request to the ticket and will update once I push the repro. Leaving thread. :thumbsup:
